output_list.reason: The 'mintToken' function has an integer overflow because there is no check for the large 'mintedAmount' parameter, which can be set during initial supply. When 'totalSupply' is added with 'mintedAmount', it causes an overflow and results in reducing the total supply of tokens.

The 'burnFrom' function has an integer overflow in following code: 'require(balanceOf[_from] >= _value); require(_value <= allowance[_from][msg.sender]);' Both 'balanceOf[_from]' and 'allowance[_from][msg.sender]' can be large values set by attackers, and '_value' can also be large, causing an overflow in these checks and reducing attackers' balances and allowances.
The 'setPrices' function has an integer overflow. Both 'newSellPrice' and 'newBuyPrice' are set by 'msg.value / buyPrice' and 'msg.value' can be large, causing an overflow in these assignments.
